text.aria-label: Title text 'D5, labelled event 147: +3.07 MW for 3.7 days from 2026-01-15. 580 status: not seen by the power rule (label not verified by the power readings). Same dates as the label at D8. NGED's labels are known to be imperfect, so a forecast that does not follow the label is not an error. Black solid: observed power. Blue dashed: observed power minus the labelled depth. Grey: C0 median and q05-q95 band. Orange: C2 median and band. Grey shade: the labelled event. Sky-blue bar along the bottom: gate on or held.'
text.tspan: D5, labelled event 147: +3.07 MW for 3.7 days from 2026-01-15. 580 status: not seen by the power rule (label not verified by the power readings). Same dates as the label at D8.
NGED's labels are known to be imperfect, so a forecast that does not follow the label is not an error. Black solid: observed power. Blue dashed: observed power minus the labelled depth.
Grey: C0 median and q05-q95 band. Orange: C2 median and band. Grey shade: the labelled event. Sky-blue bar along the bottom: gate on or held.
